title: Exponential Lot-Doubling Martingale Masked in Backtests
text: [FPA-SCAM-01] Exponential Lot-Doubling Martingale Masked in Backtests. Evidence: 12-year 99% modeling quality backtest showed deceptive 31.11% equity drawdown graph while true Relative Drawdown hit 93.02%, trading only 111 trades and escalating lot sizes to unfillable 200-1000 lots. Rule: Inspect Relative Drawdown % vs Max DD %, trade count, and sequential lot escalation (lot_k+1 > lot_k after loss).

title: Holding Losing Trades Indefinitely (Equity vs Closed Balance Illusion)
text: [FPA-SCAM-02] Holding Losing Trades Indefinitely (Equity vs Closed Balance Illusion). Evidence: Observed losing positions held open 277 to 1,287 days (~3.5 years) to avoid booking realized losses, creating rising balance curves alongside severe floating equity drawdowns. Rule: Audit max trade duration, unrealized MAE, and floating equity-to-balance divergence.

title: Ultra-Fast 0-3 Second Latency/Delayed-Feed Scalpers
text: [FPA-SCAM-03] Ultra-Fast 0-3 Second Latency/Delayed-Feed Scalpers. Evidence: Scammers showcase historical 0-3 second trades exploiting unmodeled demo feed delays or tight fixed backtest spreads that collapse under live broker spreads, slippage, and anti-arbitrage delays. Rule: Flag <5s median hold duration and test sensitivity to +0.5/+1.0/+2.0 pip spread and 100-500ms latency.

title: Missing Stop-Loss (No Hard SL Wipeout Trap)
text: [FPA-SCAM-04] Missing Stop-Loss (No Hard SL Wipeout Trap). Evidence: EAs operating with StopLoss = 0 harvest high win rates in mean-reverting regimes until a single sustained trend wipes out the entire account. Rule: Verify hard SL > 0 on every entry deal (OrderSend/CTrade) or enforce external equity-governor kill switch.
